stories.headline: EAST AND WEST.; Completion of the Great Line Spanning the Continent The Closing Work and Ceremonies at Promontory Summit. The News Flashed by Telegraph Simultaneously Over the Country. Rejoinings of the Metropolis at the Completion of the Enterprise. Celebrations in Chicago, Philadelphia and Other Cities. The Work Accomplished-Ceremonics at Promontory Summit. Announcement in Washington of the Completion of the Road-Scene in the Telegraph Office. Rejoicing in This City--The Booming of Cannon and Chiming of Bells--Magnificent Thanksgiving Services at Old Trinity--Address by Rev. Celebrations in Chicago, Philadelphia, Buffalo and Other Places. At the City Hall.
stories.summary: The transcontinental railroad was completed with ceremonies at Promontory Summit, and the news was celebrated across the country, during Reconstruction. Ulysses S. Grant's administration oversaw the final stages of the project.

stories.summary: The nation honored its Union dead on Decoration Day with ceremonies at national cemeteries, including Arlington, where President Ulysses S. Grant was in attendance. General Benjamin Butler gave a notable oration in Gloucester, Massachusetts.

stories.headline: EUROPE.; Letters from Our Correspondents in London, Madrid and Florence Our Relations with England---Effects of Mr. Sumner's Speech The Warwickshire Scandal--- Sad Revelations Important and Interesting Debates in the Spanish Cortes The subjoined letters from our European correspondents present an interesting summary of political, social and Industrial affairs in the old world The Debate on the Irish Church Bill-Summary of the Views of Leading Statesmen on the Question-Sharp Debate on the Maynooth Endowment clause Labors of the Ministry--The Case of the Mayor of Cork--The Pacific Railroad The Debates on the Constitution--Another Great Orator Developed--Thrilling Souvenirs of the Inquisition--The Separation of Church and State--Impotent Fury of the Clergy Parties in the Chamber--The New Fusion--Proposed Reconstruction of the Ministry--The Sub-Alpine Tunnel and the Suez Canal--the Alabama Question--King Victor Emmanuel Assurances of an American Citizen to the English People--Letter From Senator Grimes, of lowa
stories.summary: European correspondents reported on political and social affairs, including debates on the Irish Church Bill and the Spanish Cortes, as well as reactions to Senator Sumner's speech on US relations with England, during a time of heightened international tensions.

stories.headline: Our Trouble with England--Mr. Summer's Speech--The Administration.
stories.summary: Senator Sumner's speech on the Alabama Claims sparked controversy and discussion about US relations with England, with the administration facing challenges in its foreign policy, during a period of post-Civil War diplomacy.

rounds.blurb: The transcontinental railroad was completed with ceremonies at Promontory Summit. The nation celebrated this achievement and honored its Union dead on Decoration Day. President Ulysses S. Grant's administration oversaw these developments amidst Reconstruction and tensions with England.

stories.summary: A nationwide manhunt is underway for a second suspect in the Oklahoma City bombing, with investigators searching for links to far-right groups, as they believe there was a broader plot behind the attack, during a time of heightened concern over domestic terrorism

stories.headline: Parking Rules

stories.summary: A teenage mother on welfare, Naikeya Haley, shares her experience with a state law that denies extra benefits for additional children, as part of a broader debate on welfare reform, as the US grapples with social safety nets

stories.headline: AT LEAST 31 ARE DEAD, SCORES ARE MISSING AFTER CAR BOMB ATTACK IN OKLAHOMA CITY WRECKS 9-STORY FEDERAL OFFICE BUILDING
stories.summary: President Clinton vows to hunt down those responsible for the Oklahoma City bombing, which killed at least 31 people and destroyed a federal office building, promising to treat the perpetrators as killers, in the aftermath of a devastating domestic terrorist attack

rounds.blurb: The Oklahoma City bombing occurred, killing at least 31 people and destroying a federal office building. Investigators hunted for suspects, seeking links to far-right groups. The attack heightened concern over domestic terrorism.
